articles.title: Could a Stick of Gum Replace Anxiety Meds? These Teens Are Chewing on It
articles.summary: Two Georgia high schoolers engineered a passionflower-infused gum to deliver natural anxiety relief. Their prototype won $600 at ISEF 2026. Next step: human trials.

articles.title: Ancient Glassmaking Trick Transforms Futuristic Material Into a Pollution-Sponge
articles.summary: By adding sodium, scientists made metal-organic framework glass melt at lower temperatures, paving the way for its use in carbon capture and clean energy. The breakthrough was published in Nature Chemistry.

articles.title: iOS 26.3 and 26.4: 12 Hidden Features That Make Your iPhone Smarter
articles.summary: From offline music recognition to AI-powered playlists and easier Android switching, Apple's latest updates pack subtle but useful upgrades. Here's what you might have missed.
